# Rewrite learn/README.md and learn/UsingTheseTopics.md for the two hemispheres, three readers, and ten tree sections

## Context

Parent epic `#20498` (*Example overviews and the learning section at the kitchen-sink standard*, Intended Solution §2) and `@neo-fable-mnemosyne`'s 13-row `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393), Row 1 `learn-readme-door` + Row 9 `using-these-topics`):
- `learn/README.md` (78 lines, last edited Jul 19) is the repository-level front door to `learn/`, and `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` (67 lines, first entry in `learn/tree.json`) is the Portal's first `Using These Topics` topic.
- Both pages predate the Two Hemispheres architecture (`Body` + `Brain` joined by the Neural Link, ADR 0018), list only 5 of the 10 root sections in `learn/tree.json`, lack entry paths for the three readers (`developer evaluating the engine`, `enterprise evaluator`, `human running a coding agent`), and contain the over-claim register that `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §2 bans.

## The Problem

Measured on `dev` (`33b43ce915`):
1. **`learn/README.md` (`4,721` bytes, 78 lines):**
   - Opens with Body-only framing (`"the Application Engine for the AI Era"`) and repeats banned over-claims: `"revolutionary"` ×5 (lines 3, 6, 8, 13, 32), `"the first and only JavaScript application engine"` (line 3), `"paradigm shift"` (line 20), `"unparalleled"` (line 33), and `"framework"` self-references (lines 55, 65).
   - `Recommended Learning Path` (lines 25–43) names only 5 of the 10 root sections in `learn/tree.json` (`Benefits`, `Getting Started`, `Guides`, `Tutorials`, `Comparisons`), omitting `Using These Topics`, `Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling`, `JavaScript Classes`, `Glossary`, and `API Docs`.
   - `For AI/LLM Training` (lines 52–72) instructs readers to ingest `learn/` as static training data rather than pointing coding-agent operators to the live `Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling` shelf, `/llms.txt`, `npx neo-app`, and the Neural Link MCP tools.
2. **`learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` (`4,689` bytes, 67 lines):**
   - Opens with `"a groundbreaking approach to building lightning-fast web applications"` (line 1) and lists only 5 of the 10 `learn/tree.json` root sections (`Getting Started`, `Guides`, `Tutorials`, `Blog`, `Benefits`), omitting `Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling`, `JavaScript Classes`, `Engine vs Frameworks`, `Glossary`, and `API Docs`, with no entry path per reader.

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/tree.json` (`145` entries) defines 10 root sections:
  1. `Using These Topics` (`learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`)
  2. `Benefits` (`learn/benefits/Introduction.md`, `ArchitectureOverview.md`, and `body/*`)
  3. `Getting Started` (`learn/gettingstarted/*`)
  4. `Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling` (`learn/agentos/*` + retained ADRs)
  5. `Guides` (`learn/guides/*` across 8 sub-groups: `Fundamentals`, `The Core Engine`, `UI Building Blocks` including the 10 dock-layout guides, `Data Handling`, `User Interaction`, `Testing`, `Specific Applications/Features`, `Advanced`)
  6. `Tutorials` (`learn/tutorials/*`)
  7. `JavaScript Classes` (`learn/javascript/*`)
  8. `Engine vs Frameworks` (`learn/comparisons/*`)
  9. `Glossary` (`learn/Glossary.md`)
  10. `API Docs` (`/docs` route)
- Per `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md`:
  - **§0–§2:** Encode the Two Hemispheres (`Body` `/src/` off-main-thread multi-window UI engine + `Brain` `/ai/` Agent OS, Memory Core, and Fleet Manager, joined by the `Neural Link`), never call Neo a `"framework"`, and eliminate all three over-claim flavors (`"revolutionary"`, `"first and only"`, `"paradigm shift"`, `"unparalleled"`, `"groundbreaking"`, `"lightning-fast"`).
  - **§5:** Never hand-edit `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

Design authority: `#20498` Intended Solution §2 + [`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393) Rows 1 (`learn-readme-door`) & 9 (`using-these-topics`).

## The Fix

1. **Rewrite `learn/README.md` (`Row 1: learn-readme-door`):**
   - Open with the Two Hemispheres (`Body` + `Brain`, joined by the `Neural Link`) in concrete, verifiable mechanisms and measured proofs (`Off-Main-Thread` App/VDom/Data/Canvas workers, `SharedWorker` multi-window state without serialization sync, `100,000`-row buffered grids, and live `Neural Link` runtime inspection).
   - Provide explicit entry paths for the **three readers**:
     1. **The developer evaluating the engine** (`benefits/Introduction` → `benefits/ArchitectureOverview` → `gettingstarted/` → `guides/fundamentals`, `guides/datahandling`, `guides/uibuildingblocks` dock-layout shelf → `tutorials/` → `API Docs`).
     2. **The enterprise evaluator** (`benefits/Introduction` §§1–12 claims register → `guides/datahandling` & `uibuildingblocks` multi-window/dock architecture → `comparisons/NeoVsExtJs` & `Engine vs Frameworks` → `examples/grid/bigData` & Workstation).
     3. **The human running a coding agent** (`agentos/FleetManagerArchitecture`, `agentos/RunningTheFleetCockpit`, `agentos/NeuralLink`, `agentos/ProgressiveDisclosureSkills`, `agentos/CoreSkills`, `agentos/SeatMemoryLayer`, and retained ADRs `0007`, `0008`, `0018`, `0029`).
   - Map all **10 root sections of `learn/tree.json`** accurately.
   - Replace the outdated `"For AI/LLM Training"` block with a concrete **"Using `learn/` with a Coding Agent"** section covering the Knowledge Base MCP (`ask_knowledge_base`, `query_documents`), `/llms.txt` / `/llms-full.txt`, and `learn/tree.json`.
2. **Rewrite `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` (`Row 9: using-these-topics`):**
   - Remove the `"groundbreaking … lightning-fast"` over-claim opening and restore `# Using These Topics` as the H1.
   - Add a concise **Where to Start (Three Readers)** map and update **How the Content is Organized** to cover all **10 root sections of `learn/tree.json`** (plus the Blog).
   - Preserve the `<details>` disclosure widget and ship two runnable `live-preview` code examples: replacing the first `live-preview` block on `origin/dev` with a class-based `Example.view.MainView` (`Neo.button.Base`) example and adding a second `live-preview` block demonstrating a functional `Examples.functional.Counter` with `defineComponent` + `useConfig`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/README.md` | `#20498` §2, Row 1 (`#issuecomment-6697670393`), `guide-authoring-bar.md` §§0–5, `learn/tree.json` | Two-hemisphere opening, three-reader entry paths, all 10 `tree.json` sections mapped, zero banned over-claim words or `"framework"` self-descriptions | Relative markdown links resolve cleanly in GitHub & Portal | Self-documenting Markdown | `rg` zero-match receipt on banned over-claim terms + link target check |
| `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` | `#20498` §2, Row 9 (`#issuecomment-6697670393`), `guide-authoring-bar.md` §§0–5, `learn/tree.json` | `# Using These Topics` H1, three-reader quick routing + all 10 `tree.json` sections + Blog; preserves `<details>` disclosure block, replaces the first `live-preview` block (`Example.view.MainView` Button), and adds a second `live-preview` block (`Examples.functional.Counter` with `defineComponent` + `useConfig`) | Both `live-preview` code blocks mount and run cleanly in `Neo.code.LivePreview` on `#/learn/UsingTheseTopics` | Self-documenting Markdown | Live Portal Playwright verification on `#/learn/UsingTheseTopics` + `check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0018 (`Two Hemispheres: Body + Brain joined by the Neural Link`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (`learn/README.md` — Row 1):** Opens with the Two Hemispheres (`Body` + `Brain` + `Neural Link`), provides concrete entry paths for the three readers (developer evaluating the engine, enterprise evaluator, human running a coding agent), and maps all 10 root sections of `learn/tree.json`.
- [ ] **AC-2 (`learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` — Row 9):** Restores `# Using These Topics` as the H1, routes the three readers, describes all 10 root sections of `learn/tree.json` (plus `Blog`), preserves the `<details>` disclosure widget, replaces the first `live-preview` example with `Example.view.MainView` (`Neo.button.Base`), and adds a second `live-preview` example (`Examples.functional.Counter` with `defineComponent` + `useConfig`).
- [ ] **AC-3 (Zero Over-Claim & Category-Drift Gate):** `rg -i "revolutionary|first and only|paradigm shift|unparalleled|unprecedented|groundbreaking|lightning-fast" learn/README.md learn/UsingTheseTopics.md` returns `0` matches, and neither file refers to Neo as a `"framework"`.
- [ ] **AC-4 (Generated Files Untouched):** `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt` are not modified (`guide-authoring-bar.md §5`).

## Out of Scope

Moving or deleting entries in `learn/tree.json` (Row 2 `nav-stubs` and Row 3 `retained-decisions-nav`); rewriting `learn/benefits/body/*` (Row 10 `over-claim-sweep`) or `learn/comparisons/*` (Row 11); modifying Portal JS views.

## Avoided Traps

- Listing only 5 of the 10 `learn/tree.json` sections (the current drift in both files).
- Breaking the `<details>` disclosure block or the runnable ```javascript live-preview``` blocks in `learn/UsingTheseTopics.md`.
- Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.
